propositions: Core outbound link diffing imports vendor-specific Jira link translation from adapters, violating core/adapter boundary isolation and canonical shape comparison principles
Link comparison logic reads vendor issuelinks payload in Jira shape and translates relation→vendor_type inline in core, preventing non-Jira backends from being supported
SupportsLinks capability must provide map_remote_links (vendor→canonical translation) and link_payload_for_relation (canonical→vendor translation) so core compares only canonical relation vocabulary
ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic, matching local deps against remote links regardless of whether target key is inward or outward side
REMOVE payload must carry opaque vendor type as an immutable passenger through canonical comparison for payload reconstruction
Extended AST neutrality gate must verify outbound_links.py contains zero adapters.jira imports
